Standalone direct-payoff verifier passed 131064 exhaustive binary profiles through occupied length 16, 3159 exact formula pairs through length 80, balanced identities through 80 and a labeled example. Finite tests are not substituted for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: This natural fixed-composition, one-vacancy setting measures the prevalence, not mere existence, of stable outcomes in the established diversity-seeking game. A complete exact count at every red/blue composition and the exact balanced-population exponential scarcity rate supply useful benchmarks for equilibrium selection and population-imbalance comparisons. The structural rule is new relative to the inspected existence and potentiality statements, and the subject is an infinite family rather than an arbitrary finite slice.
